title: Endocrine-disrupting effects of 24 colorants used in food contact materials: In vitro and in silico studies.
authors: Ma, Guowei; Cui, Yiling; Li, Qian; Chen, Yuting; Guo, Peixue; Feng, Di; Zhao, Tingting
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该文研究食品接触材料中着色剂的体外与计算毒理学内分泌干扰效应，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-核受体，非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Current research on endocrine-disrupting effects of colorants utilized in food contact materials (FCMs) ramains limited. This study investigated these effects through in vitro cell models and in silico toxicological models. A total of 24 synthetic colorants were collected from the Chinese market, including azo, anthraquinone, heterocyclic and fused-ring ketones, and phthalocyanines. Their endocrine-disrupting effects mediated by estrogen and androgen receptors were evaluated using an in vitro dual-luciferase reporter gene assay. Results showed no estrogenic or anti-estrogenic effects or androgenic activity in the colorants. However, three colorants, C.I. Pigment Red 177, C.I. Pigment Orange 71, and C.I. Pigment Blue 15, elicited anti-androgenic effects with 20 % relative inhibitory concentrations (RIC(20)) of 13.08, 40.52, and 33.27 mug/mL, respectively. In addition, in silico toxicological models predicted the endocrine-disrupting activity of the 24 colorants, showing predictive accuracy ranging from 35 % to 100 % consistency with in vitro experimental outcomes. Molecular docking revealed strong binding affinity and mechanisms of interaction between three colorants and the human androgen receptor. In summary, this study combined in vitro experiments and in silico toxicological models to investigate the endocrine-disrupting effects of organic colorants with different structural types, providing new insights perspective on health risks associated with their use in FCMs.
abstract_zh: 目前关于食品接触材料（FCMs）中着色剂内分泌干扰效应的研究仍较为有限。本研究通过体外细胞模型和计算机毒理学模型探讨了这些效应。从中国市场共收集了24种合成着色剂，包括偶氮类、蒽醌类、杂环及稠环酮类，以及酞菁类。利用体外双荧光素酶报告基因实验评估了由雌激素和雄激素受体介导的内分泌干扰效应。结果显示，这些着色剂未表现出雌激素或抗雌激素效应，也无雄激素活性。然而，三种着色剂，即C.I. Pigment Red 177、C.I. Pigment Orange 71和C.I. Pigment Blue 15，引发了抗雄激素效应，其20%相对抑制浓度（RIC(20)）分别为13.08、40.52和33.07微克/毫升。此外，计算机毒理学模型预测了24种着色剂的内分泌干扰活性，其预测准确性与体外实验结果的一致性范围为35%至100%。分子对接揭示了三种着色剂与人雄激素受体之间的强结合亲和力及相互作用机制。总之，本研究结合体外实验和计算机毒理学模型，探讨了不同结构类型有机着色剂的内分泌干扰效应，为FCMs中这些物质相关的健康风险提供了新的见解。
